tools.name: verify_address
tools.description: Check a US mailing address against USPS records. Returns `deliverability`: `deliverable` when USPS recognizes the address, or `undeliverable` with a `reason` when it does not. Free: does not charge or mail anything.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "cancel_letter" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Cancel a letter sent from the user's MailSnail balance before the printer starts on it (usually possible for about a day after sending), and refund its full pri…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
